policy-and-script-roles.text: The configured application policy is the authorization anchor. Initial datum and spending destination are approved request values. A single application parameter is an interface target, not a proved implementation.

what-insert-exposes-and-binds.text: Insert binds its action, registry, key, initial datum, destination and supported native output parameters. Withdraw separately binds the exact pending Insert and refund effects. Their names use a canonical domain-separated hash.

validation-without-mutable-registry-obse.text: Application minting or spending witnesses authorize request construction without reading mutable registry state. Singular validates native conditions when consuming the request.

which-script-actually-executes.text: Sending an output does not execute the receiving script. Spending and nonzero minting invoke their respective validators. Net-zero quantities and moving existing tokens require explicit custody reasoning.

decisions-still-required.text: Encoding, configuration, disposal, refund rules, reincarnation and optional terminal-request tokens remain construction decisions. No implementation or proof is claimed.
